risks: FONT: the Fleet figure face NUM / FIGURES_FONT / font-figures is Azeret Mono (components/FuelCardBoard.tsx:68-70, tailwind.config.ts:47-52). Its @fontsource CSS covers Latin and Latin-ext only, so U+0660-0669 fall through to Cairo's arabic subset. Arabic-Indic counts and dates will render in Cairo next to Latin money in Azeret: different width, weight and height in the same table. tabular-nums / tnum alignment is not guaranteed in Cairo's Arabic digits. The owner's earlier «plain zero» rule (fleet-figures-font.spec.ts) no longer applies to Arabic-Indic («٠» is a dot).

GROUPING: formatNumber ('ar-EG') groups with «٬» (U+066C), the very mark the money rule rejects because «١٬٠٠٠» reads as «١٠٠٠». Large non-money figures (odometer «١٥٤٬٣٢٠», km totals, «١٬٢٠٤ نتيجة») would carry it. Ask the owner whether big counts and readings should group with an ASCII comma or not at all.
DECIMALS: ar-EG prints «٫» as the decimal mark (litres «٣٧٫١٠», the rate «١٫٥»). Pass minimumFractionDigits:2 for litres, which today come from toFixed(2) or en-US.
PERCENT: templates `${x}%` (DriverProfilePage:758, VehicleContractPage:249, VehicleContractsPage:347) keep the Latin '%'. Intl percent in ar-EG gives «٪», and bidi placement changes.

SHARED STRINGS: ymd(), line() (CustodyLedgerPage:534) and lineOf() (CustodyMemosPage:516) feed the screen, the print sheet AND Excel at once. Converting them in place would also change Excel (E), which waits for the owner, so convert at the display and print edges only.

PARSE-BACK: notice-render dateParts and plateParts parse with ASCII \d (plateParts also accepts ٠-٩). FuelChargingPage:90-91 does String(requestedAmount) → Number(shown). FleetSettingsPage does Number(input). An Arabic-Indic value written into any of these would parse as NaN or break; keep D values Latin or fold them with asciiDigits.

SPECS BY TEXT: many page specs find cells by their Latin text (`>${ymd}<` in vehicles-licence-state.spec:263, `>${day}` in drivers-licence-state.spec:216) or forbid Arabic-Indic outright (custody-dashboard.spec:778, receipts-screen.spec:384/951, vehicles-licence-state.spec:415-437). Those must be re-pointed, not just their expected strings changed.

OWNER HISTORY: several Latin choices are recorded owner decisions that this rule reverses. lib/licence-months.ts says «صلحهم», 2026-11-22. vehicles-licence-state.spec:415 cites the same follow-ups. Comments in AccidentsPage, ReceiptsPage and custody-words say «Latin digits, as every figure on the boards». The custody papers mirror his own Excel (Latin) and Word (Arabic-Indic money) files (lib/custody-paper-format.ts:1-7). Confirm the papers before changing them.

MONEY ON PRINT: reportMoney = toFixed(2) (lib/fleet-report-print.ts:235) and FuelCardsPage's print String(card.balance) are Latin but not comma-grouped («87835.00», «1500»). That is not B, but it is outside the rule's '1,000' form.

BIDI: Arabic-Indic digits are bidi class AN, Latin digits EN. Most figures sit in dir="ltr" spans, which is fine. Translated sentences with ranges («عن الفترة من {{from}} إلى {{to}}», pager «{from} - {to}») and the LRI/PDI-isolated negative money should be checked visually.

SHARED COMPONENT: NumberedPager (shared/ui) is also used by another module, so changing its digits changes that module too. Same for formatNumber-based fixes in FleetFigures used by every Fleet board.

SCOPE GAP: many figures on these pages are decided inside components/** (not swept here): CustodyFundHeader, CustodyFigures, LedgerFigures, CustodyTabs counts, custody-deleted-parts WhoWhen (dates and times), BoardKpi, FuelCarGroup, roster boards, fleet-dashboard tabs and charts (km-chart, tab-fuel-chart), violations panels, vehicle-contract-columns, AlarmReasonFacts, alarm-figure-card, ReceiptMemoChip, CustodyOperationDrawer. Several are in the Latin-forcing list. They need their own sweep.
Native <input type="date"> boxes show digits by the browser or OS locale; the app cannot make them Arabic-Indic.

No clipboard copy, no figure in a URL, and no text-based sort of displayed figures was found in the pages. Sorts use ISO or numeric keys (FuelCardsPage:168, LicensingPage:325, monthCountOptions sorts by the ISO month).
